subject: Consumption tally mismatch on Oct invoice
messages:
From: Michael Porter <billing@olivehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consumption tally mismatch on Oct invoice

Hi Hannah,

We're reviewing the October invoice (attached) and our internal telemetry shows ~1.92M tokens for October, but the invoice line shows 2.57M tokens billed. I've attached our exported usage for the month and a small sample of session IDs that appear duplicated in our logs.

Can you confirm which aggregation window Redwood used for October and whether any websocket/long-poll sessions might have been double-counted? We need to reconcile this before our month-end close. If there was an overcount on your side, we'd like a provisional credit while you run a full audit.

Attached: invoice_202610.pdf (PDF), usage-export-202610.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Michael Porter
Head of Finance, OliveHealth
billing@olivehealth.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Michael Porter <billing@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption tally mismatch on Oct invoice

Hi Michael — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the export. Sorry for the disruption right before close. We'll prioritize this.

Quick notes / next steps:
- I'll open a metering investigation with our billing ops and telemetry team; looping Marcus (billing ops) and Jonas (metering infra).
- Could you confirm the timezone and any TTL session semantics for the sample session IDs (a brief text reply is fine).
- As a gesture, if we identify an obvious double-count on our side, we can apply a provisional credit for the duplicated portion while we complete the audit.

Target ETA: I'll aim to have an initial triage and proposed credit amount within 48 business hours. If anything looks clearly larger we'll escalate.

— Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Michael Porter <billing@olivehealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption tally mismatch on Oct invoice

Hi Michael — Marcus from Billing Ops here. Thanks for the export; that helps a lot. A few quick observations from a preliminary scan of the attached CSV you provided (usage-export-202610.csv):

- We see clustered bursts where your reported session token counts are ~1.9M and our backend aggregated to ~2.57M. The delta (~650k tokens) maps to repeated request IDs for a small subset of sessions.
- Possible causes we're investigating: overlapping websocket sessions that reopened within our attribution window, and a legacy client that retried requests with preserved prefixes causing KV-cache replays to be counted more than once.
- Can you paste a 3-line sample from your client logs for session IDs: sess-7a9f, sess-7a9f-retry, sess-e12b? That will help us correlate timestamps precisely.

Provisional plan:
1) We'll run a deduplication audit against our raw request logs for Oct and produce a reconciliation CSV.
2) If we confirm duplication attributable to our attribution window, we'll propose a provisional credit equal to the duplicated token amount (estimate: 650,000 tokens) on the Nov invoice pending final reconciliation.
3) Naomi (Finance) is CC'd to approve provisional credit once we agree on the reconciled number.

Attachments / evidence needed from you: the 3-line client log sample above and any note about client retry windows. We'll start the audit as soon as we have that.

Attachments: (we will upload internal raw logs and the reconciliation CSV once audit completes)

— Marcus Lin
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Michael Porter <billing@olivehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveHealth Finance <invoices@olivehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption tally mismatch on Oct invoice

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the quick look. Per your request, attached is the 3-line client snippet and the full CSV (usage-export-202610.csv). The client logs indicate a 30s retry window from our side; the three session IDs you asked about are included.

We're comfortable with the provisional credit approach you outlined (650k tokens) while you complete the audit. Please confirm the amount in USD on the Nov statement and send a DocuSign for the provisional credit agreement so our finance team can sign off.

Attached: usage-export-202610.csv (CSV), client-snippets.txt (TXT)

Thanks,
Michael Porter
Head of Finance, OliveHealth
billing@olivehealth.com
